page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is a general-purpose instance type built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. With a 1:1 ratio of threads to physical cores, this instance avoids hyperthreading, providing dedicated execution resources per vCPU. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage options for persistent data. Network performance is a key characteristic, offering a baseline bandwidth of 160 Gbps to support high-throughput data transfers. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation and high-density memory configuration position this server as a premium resource tier, optimized for workloads requiring predictable CPU execution without resource contention.

The combination of 128 dedicated cores, 512.0 GB of RAM, and 160 Gbps network bandwidth makes this instance suitable for large-scale enterprise applications, high-throughput web serving, distributed databases, and parallel computing tasks that demand consistent CPU performance without hyperthreading overhead.
